data.title: Rain at the Last Station
data.excerpt: He always got off at the same station, even though the person he was waiting for had stopped coming years ago.

data.title: The Empty Seat at the Cafe
data.excerpt: Every afternoon, she ordered two cups of coffee even though she had been sitting alone for three years.

data.title: The Letter Never Sent
data.excerpt: Some things are easier to write than to say, especially to someone who can no longer answer.

data.title: The Light That Stayed On
data.excerpt: The porch light in that house stayed on until morning. Not because someone forgot to turn it off, but because someone was still hoping.

data.title: The Person Beside Me
data.excerpt: The journey lasted only two hours, but a conversation with the stranger beside him changed something inside him.

data.title: A Message at Two
data.excerpt: At exactly two in the morning, his phone rang. The message contained only three words: "I am home."
